about: Who presents La Porte Weather Now's forecast: the line at the top of every Daily Scoop and under the home page's Next 24 hours (laporteweathernow.com). While the spot is open, sponsor stays null and both pages invite local businesses to sponsor. When a business signs on, fill in sponsor like the example; the pages update within about 10 minutes, no site publish needed. Never shown on the Emergency view or in alerts.

example.name: Smith Roofing
example.line: Roofing and gutters across La Porte County
